name: BITTERSWEET FOOLS
source:
This is the first game of [url=/p27]minori[/url].

The protagonist is [url=/c56193]Alan[/url], a former mafia assassin. He was required to go into hiding after a job and is now living in Florence, Italy. His days of peace and quiet comes to an end when he meets with the granddaughter of a mafia leader...

[Edited and translated from [url=http://www.minori.ph/lineup/bsf/story.html]the official page[/url]]
translation:
这是[url=/p27]minori[/url]的首部作品。

主人公[url=/c56193]阿兰[/url]曾是黑手党的杀手。一次任务过后，他奉命隐姓埋名，如今住在意大利佛罗伦萨。当他遇见一名黑手党首领的孙女时，平静安宁的生活也就此宣告结束……

[编辑并翻译自[url=http://www.minori.ph/lineup/bsf/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
